documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9.0 Tensor.add_ is documented as the in-place version of Tensor.add().
The MindSpore 2.9.0 Tensor page says all modes of CPU and GPU do not support in-place operations yet.

This finding is therefore scoped to inconsistent successful CPU behavior: unsupported in-place calls should fail clearly or behave consistently, not silently no-op in one form and mutate/alias differently in another.
